# TDPdf v3.0.0.0

**Work with several marks at once, edit pictures and paragraphs on the page, compare PDFs, read EPUB and DjVu books, and colour-managed viewing and printing.**

## Marks

- Select several marks with Shift+click, Ctrl+click or a drag box, then move, nudge, delete or restyle them together.
- Copy, cut and paste marks and pictures, within a document and between TDPdf windows.
- Group marks with Ctrl+G, and align, space and size several marks at once.
- Stamps: Approved, Draft, Confidential and more, or your own text or picture. Other PDF viewers show them as stamps.
- Watermarks and page numbers on a range of pages, with a preview. You can remove them again later.

## Pages and pictures

- Click a picture on the page to move, resize, delete, copy, replace or save it.
- Cut a box or one colour area out of a picture as a transparent picture.
- Hold Ctrl and click a line to edit the whole paragraph. It reflows in the document's own font.
- Rasterize Region turns a box into a picture and takes the text under it off the page.
- Merge Files lets you add files and folders, put them in order, and leave out or rearrange pages. Form fields and bookmarks are kept.

## Documents

- Compare two PDFs side by side or overlaid, with every difference listed. Press Alt+Shift+V.
- Check Accessibility lists accessibility problems, jumps to each one, and fixes the language, title and tagged flag.
- Open EPUB and DjVu books in a tab, and save them as PDF.
- Export a PDF as an EPUB book for phones and e-readers.
- See and save the files attached to a PDF.
- Fill a form from an FDF or XFDF file.
- Save Flattened lets you choose the resolution and shows the size first.

## Viewing and windows

- Each tab keeps its own page view, and Two pages, continuous shows facing pages as scrolling rows.
- The Pages sidebar can show two thumbnails per row and be dragged wider.
- Split view puts two windows side by side. The same document twice opens read-only and updates when you save.
- Reopen a closed tab with Ctrl+Shift+T, and pick up your last session when TDPdf starts.
- Open and Save remember a folder for each task, list your recent folders and show a preview.
- Right-click menus match what you click, with quick buttons and colour and opacity controls. Edit Menu lets you reorder or hide items.
- After an update, What's new shows what changed since the version you last used.

## Colour

- On a monitor with its own colour profile, pages show their real colours.
- The print window has a Color section for printer profiles, rendering intent and a print preview. Leave it on Driver default and printing works exactly as before.

## Signatures

- The signature editor sets ink colour and pen width, cleans up a photographed signature, and adds a date line when you place it.
- Save a signature as a picture to use on the signing page's Upload tab.

## Security and privacy

- Your settings now carry over when TDPdf updates. Before, every update reset them.
- Redaction checks that pictures under a mark are gone from the saved file, and removes attached files.
- Deleting a picture removes it from the saved file.
- TDPdf starts Windows tools and loads Windows libraries only from the Windows folder.
- The uninstall clean-up can no longer be swapped or hijacked.
- An elevated TDPdf only accepts files from elevated programs.
- Dropped zip files are checked as they unpack, and their folders are cleaned up.
- The signing window no longer asks for permissions, starts downloads or opens pop-ups by itself.
- Saving over a weakly encrypted file warns that it stays weak.

## Fixes

- If a form's values can't be written while saving, TDPdf says so instead of dropping them.
- Text edits and page transforms delete the copies they replace.
- A failed file open after dragging a tab now says why.
